summary: In app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts, formatCitation's degraded returns must carry the same two invariants as every success path: the '- ' Markdown list marker and the '> "snippet"' transcript blockquote. Today the two YouTube fallback returns (new URL() throwing on an unparseable video_url, and a video_url with no v parameter) emit '<title> (timestamp link unavailable) — <range>' with neither, silently dropping the transcript snippet and merging the entry into the previous list item when rendered; the Dynamous empty-lesson_url return keeps the snippet but omits the marker. Augment those three returns only; the existing '(timestamp link unavailable)' text, the range, the console.warn payloads, and all success-path formats are preserved, and exportMarkdown.ts is the only production file changed.
